title: Get Aggregator Working End to End
description: Get aggregator working end to end. Currently no windows show content. Error: Fehlendes Fenster: puzzle3d-main-perspective
summary:
Fixed aggregator windows showing "Fehlendes Fenster: puzzle3d-main-perspective" (and empty Top pane).

Root cause: default layout seeds two instances of `puzzle3d-main` (`puzzle3d-main-top`, `puzzle3d-main-perspective`). A concurrent `refreshUi` from boot `setActiveExample` could run with a stale empty `extraWindowInstances` closure after the session-switch refresh had already written extras, then `mergeRecordPreservingIdentity` replaced the whole window-UI map with only the bare kind id — wiping instance-keyed bodies while the layout still referenced them.

Fix in framework/renderer/react/index.tsx:
1. Seed default-layout extras + shell layout synchronously when creating the boot session (host + playground paths).
2. Keep `extraWindowInstancesRef` updated on every seed/split/drop/retitle write; `refreshUi` and action dispatch read the ref, never the render-closure snapshot.
3. Drop `extraWindowInstances` from `refreshUi` deps so seeding extras does not schedule a second full refresh.

Verified: layout-seed vitest (3/3), browser smoke on http://127.0.0.1:6023 — no missing-window text, 2 window panes (Top + Perspective), introduction chrome present.
